notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.content:
[h1]Changelog[/h1]

* Implemented keybindings. Now you can finally bind keys to your hearts content! (I have personally spent 2 hours in the keybinding screen because it is simply so much fun!)

* Implemented a permanent crosshair setting

* Also did some smaller and insignificant bugfixes

[h2]Stay fishy![/h2]

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.content:
[h1]Changelog[/h1]

* Changed fish damage calculations (it no longer makes use of RNG).

* Fixed a bug where the fish would eternally dance while trying to attack you.

* Improved audio log volumes! ('!' means we made them louder)

* Fixed a bug where you would sometimes be at the first checkpoint after starting a New Game

* Fixed a bug where the fish would become a skinny legend and sneak through closing doors

We'll be adding more settings and QOL updates in the next hotfix. 

[h2]Stay fishy![/h2]

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
[h1]Changelog:[/h1]

* Fixed game breaking bug where dying after solving the arrow puzzle
   meant you were soft-locked in the first level.

* Fixed some pathfinding issues where the fish would transcend the mortal realm
   and walk through objects.

* Made the graphical settings (Low, Medium, High) have more effect

* Added a Mouse Smoothing toggle

* Added an Invert Y-Axis toggle

* Improved performance in Command Bridge

[h2]Thanks for all the support so far! Stay fishy.[/h2]
